title: Reject trust rotation onto an existing pinned identity
description: TrustStore.rotate_key deletes the old IID then assigns _entries[new_iid] without checking whether the replacement key is already pinned. A valid rotation can silently overwrite another peer's trust level, revocation state, timestamps, and metadata (or merge two peer identities). Reject any distinct incumbent destination entry before mutation/persistence and add unchanged-state regression coverage.
